name: Luvus
author: Ricardo Liberato
description: Your luvus coding agents in the Omarchy bar — who is working, who is blocked, and a click to go there.

barWidget.description: Agent status from luvus. Click: the agent panel. Middle click: refresh. Right click: jump to whatever needs you.

schema.label: Session
schema.description: Which luvus server session to watch. Empty means the default one — the answer for almost everybody. Named sessions are listed by: luvus session list

schema.label: luvus binary
schema.description: Left as a bare name it is resolved on PATH. The shell does not always inherit a login PATH, so set an absolute path (~/.local/bin/luvus) if the widget reports the binary missing while your terminal finds it.

schema.label: Live updates
schema.description: Hold a `luvus events` subscription open and refresh the moment an agent changes state, instead of waiting for the 30s fallback poll. Turn it off to fall back to polling alone.

schema.label: Hide when nothing is running
schema.description: Show the widget only when an agent is working or blocked. It stays visible while the panel is open.

schema.label: Terminal window class
schema.description: Focusing a luvus pane moves the cursor inside the TUI; it cannot raise the terminal that hosts it. Set the Hyprland class of that terminal (see: hyprctl clients) and the widget will raise the window too. Empty means focus the pane and leave the window alone.
